note: MRA : services d'inférence à haut débit fournis par Cerebras à OpenAI OpCo, LLC, en vigueur le 24 décembre 2025 ; corps à lire en passe C (D-0036)
quote: This Master Relationship Agreement (including all Supplemental Addenda and Exhibits attached hereto) (collectively, the "Agreement") governs the provision of the Services by Cerebras Systems Inc. ("Cerebras") to OpenAI OpCo, LLC ("OpenAI") (each a "Party" and collectively, the "Parties") and is effective as of December 24, 2025 (the "Effective Date").
